triggerCases.prompt: Write a concise pull-request description from this completed diff.
Update this pull request's description to match its current diff and preserve the issue link.
Review this pull request and give me actionable findings.
Implement the dialog focus fix and verify it.

outputCases.prompt: Draft the pull-request description locally. Do not update GitHub.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A concise description that follows the repository template, preserves existing context, and gives behavior-focused verification without changing GitHub.
assertions: The draft preserves the related issue link and manually added keyboard-regression note, and uses the repository's What, Why, How, and Testing Instructions headings.
The What and Why sections lead with the user-visible focus-restoration outcome rather than implementation mechanics.
Testing Instructions describe the exact dialog interaction and expected focus result.
Routine lint and unit-test commands are omitted from the primary manual instructions or placed in secondary details.
The workflow returns a local draft and does not update the remote pull request.
